test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election, two candidates are contesting. The winner got 48% of total votes. His opponent got 34% of total votes and lost the election by 21000 votes. Rest of the votes were invalid. The total number of votes is:
solution:
**Given:**

Votes received by winner = 48%

Votes received by opponent = 34%

Win margin = 21000 votes

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of votes be 100x

So, Votes of winner = 100x × 48/100 = 48x

Votes of opponent = 100x × 34/100 = 34x

Difference in Votes = 48x - 34x = 21000

⇒ 14x = 21000

⇒ x = 21000/14 = 1500

So, total votes = 1500 × 100 = 150000

**∴ The total number of valid votes is 150000.**
